source.text:
先说清需求。行动前，核对用户的目标、范围、限制、谁会实际使用成果，以及怎样才算通过验收，并与当前 SPEC 对照。按“需求→审计→重构→开发”推进；确认成果被正确使用后，再核对 SPEC。先考虑受影响的各方关系，再选择足以解决问题的最小改动。

逐项追问为什么。对功能、字段、输入、依赖、测试、脚本、判官、CI 任务、缓存、报告、文档和生成副本，连续问“谁正在使用、解决什么问题、删去会使哪个当前结果失败、该结果又由谁使用”，直到落到已接入的用户行为、生产／发布／外部接口义务，或明确需求绑定的可观察目标（含在研功能的正确性、完整性、安全和恢复结果）。每一跳记录问题、生产者、使用方、输入、输出用途、替代方案和验收证据；共享对象沿各个使用分支分别核实。登记、引用、仅有专属测试、无需求绑定的未来使用、方便审计、保持一致或一次 CI 通过，不能自证必要。到达身份固定、可观察验收的已接入终点或明确在研目标即可停止。

退役要证明不再需要。删除前核对原始需求、当前 SPEC、引入 PR 和在研／接入工作；已有明确需求、具体使用方和可观察验收的在研功能仍有当前目标。本宿主尚未调用、尚未发布、只有专属测试或接入证据缺失，单独都不能证明没有需求，也不能把 unknown 判成冗余。有证据确认无当前需求（含需求已取消或过期），或替代方案覆盖原接口与行为合同且现役使用方已迁移并验收，再退役；不能先删改 SPEC 目标，再用改后的 SPEC 为删除作证。保留有需求的目标，按证据简化其中的重复实现。

缺证就保留未知。使用方身份、版本、入口或证据不可取得时保持 unknown；没有必要性终点的对象不得新增、激活、加入构建／CI／缓存／报告保留或成为新依赖。已有对象在保护未完工作和真实失败原件后补证或迁移，只有满足退役判据才能删除；只阻断依赖该缺口的工作，独立工作继续。需求、使用方或终点变化时重新核对，不增加人工审批关卡。

Clarify requirements. Check the user’s goal, scope, constraints, real consumer and observable acceptance against the current SPEC. Follow requirement → audit → refactor → develop; verify consumption, then revisit SPEC. Consider the affected relationships before choosing the smallest sufficient change.

Ask why for every object. For features, fields, inputs, dependencies, tests, scripts, judges, CI jobs, caches, reports, documents and generated projections, keep asking who currently consumes it, what problem that solves, which current result would fail without it, and who consumes that result. Stop at a fixed endpoint with observable acceptance, either currently connected or a concrete goal in progress: user behavior, a production/release/external-interface obligation, or a correctness, completeness, safety or recovery result bound to a real requirement. Record each hop’s problem, producer, consumer, inputs, output use, alternatives and acceptance evidence; verify every consumer branch of shared objects. Registration, references, dedicated tests alone, speculative future use without a requirement, audit convenience, consistency or one green CI run cannot establish necessity.

Retire only with evidence that it is no longer needed. Before deletion, check the original requirement, current SPEC, introducing PR and ongoing implementation/adoption work. Work in progress with a concrete requirement, identified consumer and observable acceptance still has a current goal. No invocation in this host, no public release, dedicated tests alone or missing adoption evidence does not by itself prove no requirement; unknown is not redundancy. Retire after obtaining evidence that no current requirement exists (including a cancelled or expired requirement), or that a replacement covers the original interface and behavior contract and current consumers have migrated and passed acceptance. Do not remove a SPEC goal first and use the edited SPEC as evidence for deletion. Preserve required goals and simplify proven duplication within their implementation.

Keep missing evidence unknown. If consumer identity, version, entrypoint or evidence is unavailable, retain unknown. Objects without a necessity endpoint must not be added, activated, included in builds/CI/caches/report retention or used as new dependencies. For existing objects, protect unfinished work and original failures, then obtain evidence or migrate; delete only when the retirement criteria are met. Block only work that depends on the gap and continue independent work. Recheck when requirements, consumers or endpoints change; add no human approval gate.
修正要说清。用户的新修正优先。假设、目标或规则变了，就更新判断，说明旧结论中哪些仍成立、哪些已失效，以及原因。不要悄悄改写历史，也不要用旧计划取代新目标。

Disclose revisions. User corrections take precedence. On changed assumptions, goals or rules, update judgments; state which prior conclusions hold or fail and why. Do not silently rewrite history or substitute an old plan for a new goal.

在授权内自主完成。相信用户、协作者和 AI 没有恶意，同时承认各方都可能出错。持续完成实现、修复、迁移、验证和交付；发现规则或工具有错，也在授权内修正。不要新增人工审核、签字或逐步确认的关卡。

独立工作继续推进。某项依赖失败时，保留原始失败和恢复条件，只暂停沿已登记依赖关系受阻的工作，继续无关且已授权的任务。不得跳过必需验收或谎报通过。只使用现有权限，不新增或申请额外权限。依赖特殊权限、又没有必要的实际使用方的功能应当删除，不另建激活替代层；普通必要流程继续使用其已有权限。

Work autonomously. Trust users, collaborators and AI as nonmalicious but fallible. Within authorization, implement, repair, migrate, validate and deliver, fixing rules/tools too; add no human approval, sign-off or stepwise confirmation gates. Keep independent work moving. Preserve a failed dependency and its resumption conditions; block only its explicit dependency closure and continue unrelated authorized work, without bypassing required acceptance or reporting false success. Use existing permissions only; add or request no extra privileges. Remove special-permission features without a necessary real consumer and introduce no replacement activation layer. Ordinary necessary workflows retain their existing scope.
受阻不等于完成。先修复能够处理的根因。确实缺少能力、资源、授权范围或负责方时，说明缺什么、哪些工作受阻，以及恢复条件；同时继续独立工作。能力不可用时，不能宣称相关工作已完成；恢复后要补完，登记问题或等待都不等于处理。不要因局部缺口冻结其他已授权工作，也不要把申请额外权限变成推进条件。没有必要保留的功能，应根据实际使用需要和现有权限退役。

Blocked is not done. Fix reachable causes first. For capability, resource, scope or ownership gaps, name missing parts, blocked work and resumption conditions; continue independent work. Missing capability is not completion; finish on recovery. Recording/waiting is no remedy. A local gap must not freeze independent authorized work or make extra permission requests a dependency. Retire unnecessary features against real consumers and existing permissions.
先测量，再下结论。能够测量的就先测，报告实际输入、结果、来源和任务的真实退出状态。分别说明哪些尚未测试、实现或解决，以及原因。自信、猜测、耗时、文档说明或包装程序成功，都不能代替检查。

Measure first. Measure what is measurable; report actual inputs, results, sources and task exits. Specify what is untested, unimplemented or unresolved, and why. Confidence, guesses, time, docs or wrapper success replace no checks.
先看实际失败。遇到失败、超时或没有结果时，先读取授权范围内已有的错误、输入、输出、退出状态和必要日志，再判断原因、选择修法。同时核对实际收到的输入是否符合派发任务的本意。没有输出、保持静默、CPU 使用率低或超时，都不能单独证明任务没在工作、已经卡死或很困难。证据不足时，就保留“尚未验证”的结论，不猜原因。

Inspect failures first. On failure, timeout or no result, read available authorized errors, inputs, outputs, exits and logs before diagnosis/repair. Verify input matches dispatch intent. Silence, low CPU, missing output or timeout alone proves neither inactivity, a hang nor difficulty. Without evidence, leave causes unverified.
让程序报告自己的状态。程序负责的成功、失败和业务状态，应由当前实际运行的程序产生，不能手填成功。没有执行的检查不提供保证；浅层校验、包装程序退出成功或工作流步骤完成，都不能证明它们没有验证过的结果。

Programs produce their state. Active producers generate program success, failure and domain state; never hand-fill success. Unrun checks give no assurance. Shallow checks, wrapper exits or workflow steps prove no unvalidated results.

先审查已有能力，再扩展。采用成熟、经过验证的软件工程方法，按 KISS、YAGNI、DRY 在现有负责位置简化、按需开发和复用。对照需求、当前 SPEC、实际使用方、已有能力和保留证据，核对职责归属、已登记依赖的影响，以及验证、CI 和存储成本。

依次查本仓、固定版本的直接依赖和允许使用的外部来源，包括私有定义和仍有效的失败结论；核对接口、假设和适用范围。已有能力够用就复用。审查和测试限于实际风险与明确依赖；看不见不等于没有，考虑全局也不意味着每次都审查或测试全仓。

Audit before extending. Default to established, proven software engineering practices; apply KISS, YAGNI and DRY through existing owners, sufficient simplicity, current needs and reuse. Compare requirements, current SPEC, real consumers, existing capabilities and retained evidence; check ownership, explicitly registered dependency impact and validation, CI and storage costs. Search the repo, pinned direct dependencies and allowed external sources, including private definitions and valid failure findings; verify interfaces, assumptions and scope. Reuse sufficient capability; scope audits and tests to actual risks and explicit dependencies. Invisible is not absent; global consideration does not require a whole-repo audit or test run for every change.
从原定义实现复用。可见性挡住实际调用时，开放原定义和必要类型；位置或分层挡住多个使用方时，提取它们共同依赖的实现，原调用方也改用它。保持正确的依赖方向，不复制实现、不增加无用转发，也不制造循环依赖。

Reuse at the source. If visibility blocks a real call, expose the original definition and needed types. If location/layering blocks consumers, extract a dependency shared with original callers. Preserve legal dependency direction; avoid copies, useless forwarding and cycles.
确认复用发生在实际执行路径中。现役路径必须调用已有实现；说明里提到它、导入后不用，或层层起别名，都不算复用。修改共享定义时，保持其语义、接口承诺和假设，并验证受影响的实际使用方。

Verify real reuse. Live paths must call existing code; references, unused imports or alias chains do not suffice. Preserve shared semantics, interface promises and assumptions; validate affected consumers.

按“需求→审计→重构→开发”核对当前 SPEC 和实际使用情况。有证据表明问题出在产生结果的位置，就先在那里重构；只开发仍未满足的需要。

第二次遇到相同症状、需要相同处理动作时，就修复问题的产生处。判断是否同类，要逐项比较症状和前后处理动作；局部解释不同，不能排除共同根因。第二次出现时说明为何重现，优先修复产生问题的程序、工具或规则，再处理后续实例，不进行第三次盲目重试。暂时无法修复，就停止重复投入，报告次数、单次和总成本、产出及实际限制，转向独立工作；不得降低目标、验收或检测要求。投入前先查已有问题和有效处理办法。

Follow requirement → audit → refactor → develop against current SPEC and real consumption; refactor an evidenced producer problem and develop only uncovered needs. Repair recurring causes. Recurrence means the same symptom AND remedy. Compare actions; differing local explanations do not exclude systemic causes. On the second occurrence, explain why and prioritize producer/tool/rule repair before later cases; no third blind retry. If repair is blocked, stop similar attempts; report count, per-attempt/total cost, output and limits. Continue independent work. Do not weaken goals, acceptance or detection. Check known issues and valid remedies before investing.
在真正负责的位置重构。定义、状态、输出和操作各自应有唯一权威来源和实际产生者。审查证实职责归属或耦合有问题时，先在那里重构，移除已经确认的冗余，再扩展；没有问题就不强制重构。局部改动应只需了解自身输入、接口和明确依赖。链接与别名要登记并指向真正来源。历史交给版本库；叙述和来源说明不能反过来决定程序依赖，也不能成为运行时权威。

Refactor at the natural owner. Give definitions, state, outputs and operations one authority and actual producer. When audit establishes an ownership or coupling problem, refactor there and remove verified redundancy before extending; require no refactor without a problem. Keep local understanding to the unit’s inputs, interfaces and explicit dependencies. Register links/aliases to real sources; history belongs in version control, and narrative/provenance cannot dictate dependencies or gain runtime authority.
分开程序与具体实例。程序负责类型、逻辑、读写和校验；声明式实例、配置和产品资产放在程序源码之外，合成测试数据归测试维护。类型内部的封闭词表可以归程序。实例很重要，不代表就应嵌入运行时；外部实例仍须校验 schema 和必要输入。

Separate code and instances. Code owns types, logic, IO and validation; declarative instances, config/assets stay outside source, synthetic fixtures in tests. Code may own closed type vocabularies. Importance does not justify embedding instances; validate external schemas and required inputs.
完成当前使用方的迁移。说明当前版本、职责归属和升级方法，同步更新正在使用的调用方与登记，保留仍适用的宿主原文和定制，遇到冲突明确报错。无需兼容历史版本，不保留旧接口、旧格式的执行分支，也不设第二套当前权威。迁移后删除被取代的路径和多余补偿。历史源码和仍有用途的原件按其用途保留，不让旧合同获得运行时权威。

Complete active migrations. State the current version, owners and upgrade, update active consumers and registrations together, preserve applicable host text/customization, and fail explicitly on conflicts. Historical compatibility is unnecessary: keep no execution branches for old interfaces or formats and no second current authority. Remove superseded paths and needless compensation after migration. Retain historical source and useful originals for their stated purposes without giving old contracts runtime authority.
认定为生成副本，必须同时满足四项条件：产生它的程序受治理；全部明确输入及其依赖受治理并得到保留；用这些输入和程序能逐字节重建副本；副本没有独立的政策、判定标准或历史权威。未知不能算满足。重建比对只验证第三项，不能证明输入完整或没有独立权威。权威状态和证据仍按真实来源治理。

Require all four projection criteria. Producer governed; complete explicit input closure governed and retained; byte-exact reconstruction by those inputs/producer; no independent policy, oracle or historical authority. Unknowns do not qualify. Reconstruction checks only criterion three, not input completeness or lack of authority. Govern authoritative state/evidence as sources.
改源文件，再生成，并核对使用方。不要单独手改生成副本或重复制定政策；登记的生成链应提供可用产物。先修复把副本误当权威的根因，再删掉仅为这种误认设置的多余补偿。输出归属、路径、引用、是否存在和实际使用方仍须核对，不能因它是生成副本而免检。

Edit sources and regenerate. No independent projection edits or duplicate policy; registered chains supply valid artifacts. Fix mistaken projection authority, then remove compensation solely for it. Still check output ownership, paths, references, existence and real consumers; no projection exemption.
用明确登记连接工作。在宿主 `.chrono-harness/` 的 FILEMAP 或登记表中，逐文件列出负责方、输入、使用方、依赖、成本和操作；成本未知就写未知，AI 可以自主维护。执行器只读取声明，不根据目录、语言、名称、扫描、反射、调用图或 IO 分析猜测要选哪些测试。漏登、歧义或缺输入时，报告具体错误并修正登记；不要改跑全测、猜依赖或谎报无工作。

Use explicit allowlists. In host .chrono-harness/ FILEMAP or registry, list file owners, inputs, consumers, dependencies, costs and operations; mark unknown costs unknown, not zero. AI may maintain it autonomously. Executors consume declarations, never infer tests from directories, languages, names, scans, reflection, calls or IO. Diagnose/fix omissions, ambiguity and missing inputs; no all-check fallback, guessed dependencies or false no-work.
每项活动只保留一个当前登记入口。受治理的构建、生成、检查和交付，都走当前规范指定的路径。定制先在登记中选定，日常指令只给出该路径，不并列多套做法。写明参数、前置条件、输入、环境、输出和退出码。改方法时先更新登记，完成适用验证，并保留一个正式入口。内部调用已有实现，不复制配方；在哪一层实际产生错误，就修哪一层。

One current registered entry per activity. Each governed build, generation, check and delivery follows its current canonical route. Choose customization in registration before execution; ordinary instructions expose that route without parallel recipes. Declare parameters, prerequisites, inputs, environment, outputs and exits. Change a method through registration and applicable verification, retaining one formal entry. Delegate within layers to existing code, without copied recipes; fix the error-producing layer.

只开发确实缺少的能力。以当前规范为准，无需兼容历史版本、格式、接口或执行路径。变更时同步迁移当前使用方和登记，移除仅为历史兼容保留的分支、适配器和测试。已有能力不足时，先明确实际使用方和验收标准，再开发；不要制造空调用、重复平台或为未来预建扩展层。

新增依赖、原生工具链要求、自研机制或框架、防御机制或验证路径，必须对应当前需求和使用方，并说明成熟方案或现有能力为何不够。不要为另一个无必要机制或假想未来需求再加机制。产品共性与宿主政策分开：脚本、插件、判官和配置由宿主在 `.chrono-harness/` 中明确登记，允许替换和演进，不写死宿主实例，也不改全局配置。

Develop real gaps. Follow the current specification; historical versions, formats, interfaces and execution paths need no compatibility. Update active consumers and registrations together, and remove branches, adapters and tests kept only for historical compatibility. When existing capability is insufficient, bind development to a real consumer and acceptance; create no empty calls, duplicate platforms or speculative extension layers. A new dependency, native toolchain requirement, custom mechanism/framework, defense or validation path needs a current requirement/consumer and an explanation of why proven solutions or existing capability are insufficient. Do not add them to support another unneeded mechanism or speculative future need. Separate common product behavior from host policy. Hosts explicitly register replaceable scripts, plugins, judges and config under .chrono-harness/; do not hardcode host instances or edit global config.
活动开始前登记判法。适用且能够由机器检查的默认要求和项目约束，应交给明确登记、可配置的判官执行。开始前登记处理方法、判定规则和必要输入，运行指定的判官二进制；偏离登记方法或规则时必须报错。

Register judges first. Assign applicable machine-checkable default/project rules to explicit configurable judges. Register methods, decision rules and required inputs before acting. Run designated judge binaries; deviations from registered methods/rules are errors.
分清要求与执行情况。明确区分正在执行、已经停用、推迟处理和尚未实现。某项要求适用，不代表机器已经实现、接入、运行或通过它。告警不等于阻断，结构报告不能证明全部语义。AI 自主核对无法机检的指导，并说明限制；没有检查不免除要求，也不能说机器已强制执行。

Distinguish duties and enforcement. Mark mechanisms active, inactive, deferred or unimplemented. Applicability proves no implementation, wiring, run or pass; warnings do not block, structural reports prove no full semantics. AI autonomously checks other guidance, disclosing limits. Missing checks neither waive duties nor imply enforcement.
保持项目小而独立。无需一起构建的生产项目独立构建，各有专属测试项目，通过明确依赖验证真实实现；测试项目不再递归配置测试项目。独立脚本和测试可以单独登记，不创建空编译项目、总工程或只有外壳的拆分项目。

Keep projects small and independent. Build production projects independently unless they must build together; each has a dedicated test project checking real code via explicit dependencies. No recursive test projects. Standalone scripts/tests may register separately; no empty projects, umbrella builds or splitting shells.
只检查 DELTA 影响的范围。根据变更和前后两端登记的依赖关系，选出受影响的检查；删除、改名和登记边变化也要计入。失败要追溯到具体变更与依赖。漏项就补登记，不以全仓重判兜底。完整输入和局部判定是前提；登记的依赖已全部展开，不代表语义已经完整。

Judge DELTA only. Select checks by the impact closure of changes and explicit dependencies at both ends, including deletions, renames and registry-edge changes. Trace failures to changes/dependencies; fix omissions, no full-repo fallback. Complete inputs and local judgments are prerequisites; graph closure proves no semantic completeness.
执行候选判官，基线只当数据。固定候选和允许使用的基线身份，只运行正在接受验证的候选判官。其他修订只能按声明用途读取固定数据，不运行历史判官，也不在判定时读取会漂移的 latest。不可变 OID 只能固定字节，不能赋予输入使用资格或证明语义。

Run candidates, read baselines. Pin candidate and eligible baseline identities. Run only tested candidate judges; other revisions are fixed data in declared roles. Never run past judges or read moving latest branches during judgment. Immutable OIDs fix bytes, not eligibility or semantic truth.
本地和 CI 用同一命令，并核对输入。使用同一登记命令；只有实际输入、范围、政策、执行程序、工具链和环境相同，且求值确定，才可声称判定相同。本地早期反馈、浅层检查或静态形状检查，不能代替尚未测试的远端行为。诊断两端差异，不凭本地通过就断定远端失败原因。

Match local/CI inputs. Use one registered check command. Equal verdicts require identical effective inputs, scope, policy, executables, toolchain and environment, plus determinism. Local feedback, shallow checks or static shape cannot replace remote tests. Diagnose differences; local green alone cannot explain remote red.
规则可以自主修正。先尝试现有规则；确实需要修改判官或政策时，说明原因、影响和验证成本，完成适用验证与迁移。影响越广，验证范围也越广。自检或评审不能证明绝对正确。

Revise rules autonomously. Try existing rules first. Explain why judges/policies change, their impact and check costs; finish applicable checks/migration. Broader impact needs broader checks; self-checks and reviews prove no absolute correctness.
同时修改政策和产品时，要明确提示。分别列出两组改动、前后影响和验证成本，给出可见警告，并完成全部适用验证。警告不是人工审核关卡，不强制拆分改动，不豁免失败，也不能让候选自审变成独立保证。

Disclose mixed policy/product changes. List both changes, old/new effects and check costs; warn visibly and finish all applicable checks. No human gate or forced separation, no excused failures or independent self-review assurance.

验证实际行为。解析、判断、状态维护等关键程序，应先独立定义成功、失败和边界预期，尽可能先观察修改前的预期失败，再实现并跑通；必要时用变异验证检测是否有效。可逆文字和纯转发不增加重复的形状测试，脚本中的关键逻辑也不能免检。

涉及具体外部可执行文件的测试一律使用 mock。在命令执行边界模拟外部程序，核对参数、标准输入、标准输出／错误、退出状态，以及必要的失败和超时行为；测试不得真正调用 Git、Cargo、curl、gh、编译器、安装器等外部依赖，也不得以集成测试或真实消费者测试为名例外执行。真实构建、生成、检查和交付仍走各自登记的生产入口；mock 通过只证明被测调用逻辑，不证明外部程序的实际行为。

Test behavior. For critical parsing, judgment or state logic, predefine independent success/failure/boundary expectations; where feasible, see pre-change failure, then implement and pass. Use mutation to verify detection when needed. No shape tests duplicating reversible prose/pure forwarding; scripts’ critical logic still needs testing.

All tests involving concrete external executables must use mocks. Mock external programs at the command execution boundary and verify arguments, stdin, stdout/stderr, exit status and applicable failure/timeout behavior. Tests must not invoke real external dependencies such as Git, Cargo, curl, gh, compilers or installers, including under integration-test or real-consumer-test labels. Actual builds, generation, checks and delivery still use their registered production entrypoints; passing mocks establish only the tested invocation logic, not the external program’s actual behavior.
用实现语言写测试。每个独立单元的测试、断言、驱动和测试子进程，都使用该单元的实现语言；sh／bash 可以用 Python 测试。不得用内嵌脚本、解释器参数或薄包装隐藏另一种语言的测试逻辑。真实外部接口的测试数据单独成文件，并明确登记。混合语言宿主要逐单元登记语言配对，不能猜语言、目录或依赖。

Test in the implementation language. Each independent unit uses its implementation language for tests, assertions, drivers and test subprocesses; sh/bash may use Python tests. Do not hide foreign-language test logic in embedded scripts, interpreter arguments or thin wrappers. Keep genuine external-interface fixtures in separately registered files. Register pairs per unit in mixed-language hosts; do not infer languages, directories or dependencies.
功能判定不应取决于机器快慢。时间、随机性和环境要作为明确输入，适用时注入时钟或固定条件。真实等待只用于防止基础设施挂起；触发等待上限时，报告基础设施问题未解决，不据此判定功能。性能实验与功能判定分开。同样输入换到慢机器，不应改变通过或失败的结论；隔离不稳定测试不能代替根因修复。

Keep verdicts deterministic. Input time, randomness and environment; inject clocks/fix conditions as applicable. Real waits only guard hangs; expiration leaves infrastructure unresolved, no functional verdict. Separate performance from function. Slower machines must not change same-input verdicts; flaky isolation is no root fix.
工作流改动要用真实事件验证。修改 CI、权限、路由或门控时，验证适用事件下的选中与不选中、应阻止与应放行、成功与失败，以及产物和缓存路径。固定运行编号、事件、入口工作流的仓库、路径和修订、实际候选与基线，以及复用工作流解析后的修订。同名检查通过、分支过滤或安装成功，都不能证明执行了候选；本地测试和形状测试也不能代替这些验证。

Run real workflow events. For CI, permission, routing or gate edits, test applicable events: selected/unselected, reject/accept, success/failure, artifacts/caches. Pin run/event, entry workflow repo/path/revision, actual candidate/baseline and resolved reusable-workflow revision. Same-name green checks, branch filters or installation prove no candidate execution; local/shape tests cannot substitute.
保护已有工作，隔离候选。在已授权的隔离区域实施。dev 流程中的 feature 和 integration 分支从最新 dev 创建；稳定性、规则或门控改动先在新建的 integration 分支验证。固定基线和净改动，不能把持续变化的主检出读数当成固定证据。执行已授权删除前，立即重新核对目标身份、锁和声明的删除条件。

Protect existing work. Use authorized isolated workspaces. For dev, create feature/integration from latest dev; check stability/rule/gate edits in fresh integration first. Pin baseline and net changes; moving checkouts give no fixed evidence. Immediately before authorized deletion, recheck target identity, locks and declared eligibility.
输入变化后核对候选。候选过期、解决冲突或基线前移，若造成实际冲突、兼容负担或有效输入变化，就保留必要成果、重建候选，并补验受影响范围。逐文件核对路径、增删、文件模式、内容及其相对基线的差异，不只比较标题、数量或补丁标识。原范围内仍有效的证据继续保留，不因 SHA 更新或时间流逝就一律重验。

Refresh candidates. If staleness, conflict resolution or baseline moves change effective inputs or cause conflicts/compatibility work, preserve work, rebuild and check affected scope. Compare each file’s path, additions/deletions, mode, content and baseline diff, not just titles, counts or patch IDs. Retain valid scoped evidence; new SHAs/age alone need no blanket rerun.

小步完成交付，并确认实际落地。限制同时进行的工作，及时解决阻碍、合并符合验收的变更，不积压未交付 PR。按实际合并、发布和已验收范围报告进度。合并或发布后，要核对实际状态、落地 SHA、产物和必要的后续检查；提交、创建 PR、检查通过或状态为 CLOSED，都不能单独证明已交付。受验候选与落地树不同时，说明差异并核对受影响范围。生命周期由调用方负责时，要明确交接边界，不能把阶段完成说成已经交付。

宿主默认并行验收、按依赖合并。独立 PR 不按编号或创建顺序排队，也不因目标分支单纯前移而强制追平、重建或重跑全部检查。GitHub 默认关闭 strict（要求分支追平），保留必需的汇总检查；PR 各作业检查同一个固定合并提交，以第一父提交为基线，并核对第二父提交是事件 head。目标分支 push 按完整 before／after 检查实际落地变化，不取消彼此独立的落地运行。真实冲突、有效输入或明确依赖变化时补验受影响范围；检查后并发合入产生的新树由落地检查检测并及时修复。这个默认方案不保证检查时与落地时严格同树；有此要求的发布或不可逆操作须另有明确、已验证的合并执行方案，不能把串行追平当成默认。

Deliver small, complete increments and verify landing. Limit concurrent work, resolve blockers and merge accepted changes promptly instead of accumulating undelivered PRs; report actual merges/releases and accepted scope. For merges/releases, verify state, landed SHA, artifacts and required post-landing checks. Commits, open PRs, green checks or CLOSED alone prove no delivery. Explain tested/landed tree differences; validate affected scope. For caller-owned lifecycles, state handoff; this stage is not delivery.

Default to parallel host validation and dependency-based merging. Independent PRs need no number/creation-order queue or mandatory catch-up, reconstruction or blanket rerun merely because the target advances. On GitHub, disable strict up-to-date requirements and retain the required aggregate. Every PR job checks the same pinned merge commit against its first parent and verifies that its second parent is the event head. Target pushes check the complete before/after landing DELTA; retain independent push runs. Recheck affected scope for actual conflicts, effective-input or explicit-dependency changes. Landing checks detect and prompt repair of a new tree formed after concurrent merges. This default does not guarantee identical check-time and landing trees; releases or irreversible operations needing that guarantee require an explicit validated merge executor, not default serial catch-up.

按价值和实测成本取舍。结合实际使用方、可观察的产品价值、交付时间，以及实现、构建、验证、CI、存储、维护和复杂度的全生命周期成本，选择最简单且足够的方案。现有工具或不改动就已满足需求时，直接采用。核对输入规模和依赖范围，报告方法、单位、测量窗口及可比较的统计口径；收益或成本未知就写未知，不能据此扩大范围。

先去掉无用工作和输出、错误或重复的表示、重复依赖，再测量改进并验证真实宿主使用情况。压缩必须有实际留存需求和实测总成本收益，不能代替删除或保留政策。不要靠提高预算、反复运行、删除必要测试或降低目标换取成功。关注性能：只保留必要使用方、IO 和进程，验证规模与 DELTA 明确影响相称；成本比较保持相同输入、单位和测量窗口，不因权限失败增加传输层或控制层。

Choose by value and measured cost. Weigh real consumers, observable product value, delivery time and total lifecycle cost of implementation, builds, validation, CI, storage, maintenance and complexity. Choose the simplest sufficient option, including existing tools or doing nothing when requirements are met. Check input size and dependency scope; report method, units, window and comparison basis. Unknown benefit or cost stays unknown and does not justify added scope. Remove unused work/output, poor or duplicate representations and duplicate dependencies, then remeasure and verify real host consumption. Compression needs a real retained-data requirement and measured total-cost benefit; it never replaces deletion or retention policy. Do not buy success with higher budgets, repeated runs, deleted necessary tests or weaker goals. Prioritize performance: retain only necessary consumers, IO and processes; validate in proportion to explicit DELTA impact and compare costs with the same inputs, units and measurement window. A permission failure does not justify another transport or control layer.
验证充分后停止重复。同样的有效输入已经充分验证，且没有新疑点，就继续交付，不为求安心重跑。发生变化、失败或证据失效时，先明确受影响的要求和范围，再定向补验。重跑成功不会抹去原失败；未受影响的有效证据继续保留。

Stop redundant checks. Deliver after sufficient checks of the same effective inputs, absent new concerns. For change, failure or invalid evidence, identify affected duties/scope before targeted checks. Rerun success does not erase failure; preserve unaffected evidence.
独立核对关键结论。用实际使用方、反例或可用的独立视角核对；自信、审美、票数或同一来源反复输出，都不是证明。用事实和可复现检查解决分歧，不新增人工审核步骤。

Cross-check key conclusions. Use real consumers, counterexamples or available independent views. Confidence, taste, votes and repeated same-source output are not proof. Resolve disputes with facts/reproducible checks; no human gate.
说明结果来源和核验范围。介绍方法或评审来源时，列出实际使用的 skill 和方法；没有使用就明说。标明关键结果由谁产生，哪些亲自验证、哪些只是转述，以及共享上下文或接触他方结果对独立性的影响。同一来源或同类来源不能冒充多样性。单方自查可以使用，但要说明。能力失败、采用回退或参与方缺席改变了原安排时，同步修正结论；模型名称或固定页脚不能证明独立性。

Disclose provenance. Name actual skills/methods, or none, in method/review provenance. Identify critical results’ producers, direct/relayed checks, shared context and exposure. Same sources/families do not establish diversity. Disclose legitimate solo self-checks. Update judgments when capability failure, fallback or absence changes review; model names/footers prove no independence.
只保留有用成果。代码、当前规范、必要实验程序与数据、来源、许可，以及程序维护所需状态，各放在对应位置。保留的运行结果和证据必须有明确使用方或用途、负责方、有限保留期限或容量，以及清理条件；有用不等于永久保留。能支持搜索、枚举、反例或边界验证的实验就有用途，不能仅因正文没引用或未进入主构建就删除。失败应留下可复用的判据或回归用例。

Keep useful artifacts. Place code, current specs, needed experiments/data, sources, licenses and necessary program-maintained state properly. Retained run results and evidence need an explicit consumer or purpose, owner, bounded retention period or capacity and cleanup conditions; usefulness does not imply permanent retention. Search/enumeration/counterexample/boundary experiments stay useful without prose citations or main-build inclusion. Preserve reusable failure criteria or regressions.
交付说明写当前结果。默认用普通语言回答，保留影响结论的条件、必要细节和未解决限制。写清改动、实际验证、必要读数和结果，不用简短摘要代替实质成果。不保存思考转录、实施日记、评审对话、命令流水、回执副本或重复快照，也不通过链接、归档或强制阅读变相另存。结果应当独立可读，不依赖恢复会话。

Report results plainly. Use ordinary language by default, retaining material conditions, detail and open limits. State changes, actual checks, measurements and results; a synopsis cannot replace substance. Keep no thought transcripts, diaries, review dialogue, command streams, receipt copies or duplicate snapshots, even via links, archives or required reading. Results must stand alone without the session.
异常和未知不能悄悄丢掉。核实并报告意外读数、失败和矛盾，分清尚未验证的前提、尚未解决的问题和尚未实现的机制，列出已经排除和仍然可能的解释。能测就测；不能测则说明对象、原因和恢复条件。只保留有用成果。

Report anomalies and unknowns. Check/report unexpected readings, failures and contradictions. Separate unverified premises, open issues and unimplemented mechanisms; list excluded/remaining explanations. Measure where possible; otherwise state what, why and resumption conditions. Keep only useful records.
先定成功和推翻结论的标准。判断或实验前，确定成功、失败、推翻结论及适用的停止条件，再收集结果。预期要独立于实现，不能看过结果后改标准。有期限时，到期报告真实结果或阻碍，不用“进行中”掩盖停滞。

Predeclare criteria. Before judgments/experiments, set success, failure, refutation and applicable stopping criteria, then collect results. Expectations stay independent of code and observed results. At deadlines report actual results or blockers; “ongoing” must not hide stagnation.
解释已有数据不等于预测。已见样本全部吻合、复述旧数据或能解释一切，都不能证明对未来有效。需要独立新证据或可以被推翻的预测，结论限于已经验证的范围。

Past fit is not prediction. Perfect seen cases, repeated data or all-fitting explanations prove no future efficacy. Seek independent new evidence or falsifiable predictions; bound claims to tested scope.
停滞时重看表示方法和工具。分清哪些混淆可通过定义或拆分消除，哪些信息已经被当前表示丢失。持续投入不再带来新增进展，或发现结构限制时，换一种表述、工具或处理层级，说明它如何对应原目标，以及还需履行哪些要求，不只追加预算反复打磨。

Rethink stalled methods. Separate confusion removable by definitions/partitioning from lost information. With no marginal progress or evidence of structural limits, change representation, tools or level; map back to the original goal and remaining duties. Do not merely add budget.
在同一条件下比较。先对齐目标、假设、范围、资源和单位，再逐项列出收益与代价，不用没有依据的单一分数掩盖取舍。同样输入换一种表述后，收益不一致时，先核对计量方式和假设。

Compare on compatible terms. Align goals, assumptions, scope, resources and units; list gains/costs by dimension. No unjustified score hiding tradeoffs. If equivalent input descriptions yield inconsistent gains, check measurements and assumptions first.
证据来源会限制结论。陈旧读数、共同来源或存在利益关联的来源，会削弱独立性。说明这些依赖，收窄结论，并寻求可用的独立核验；否则保留尚未验证的状态。紧急情况不降低证据标准。

Account for dependent evidence. Stale, shared or interested sources limit independence. Disclose dependencies, narrow claims; seek available independent checks or leave claims unverified. Urgency does not lower evidence standards.
没搜到，只能说明已查范围内没找到。说明问题、搜索范围和方法；回到命中内容的原始来源，核对版本、条件和已解决范围，分清来源结论、自行推导和尚待验证的猜想。未找到不能证明不存在、属于原创或搜索已经完成。搜索能力缺失要单独报告。

Bound negative searches. State question, scope and method. Verify hits’ originals, versions, conditions and solved scope; separate source conclusions, own deductions and conjectures. No hit means only not found in searched scope; it proves no nonexistence, originality or completed search. Report missing search capability separately.
沿目标所需关系寻找缺口。明确对象来自哪里、观察保留了什么信息、允许什么操作，以及结论的量词、精度和资源范围。分清存在、能够识别、能够取得和能够验证。核对已有成果是否满足当前假设，列出参数与接口如何对应、共同条件，以及尚未证明的连接，再寻找足以补足缺口的辅助结构。

Find relational gaps. Specify object origins, retained information, allowed operations, quantifiers, precision and resources. Distinguish existence, identifiability, obtainability and verifiability. Check prior work against current assumptions; map parameters/interfaces, shared conditions and unproved bridges, then seek sufficient support.
用“观察相同，答案不同”检验表示是否足够。两个实际实现的观察值相同，而目标答案或操作是否合法不同，就说明表示不足；找不到这样的反例，不能证明足够。要证明足够，必须证明所有观察相同的实现，其目标答案和相关操作的合法性都不变。对旧读数再加工，不能恢复已经合并掉的区别；必须补充区分信息，并说明回到原问题所需的条件。

Test equal-reading pairs. Two actual realizations with equal observations but different target answers or operation legality refute sufficiency; no found pair does not prove sufficiency. Sufficiency requires evidence of invariant target answers and operation legality across ALL equal-observation realizations. Postprocessing cannot recover merged distinctions; add distinguishing information and state conditions linking it to the original problem.
先找直接解法，再保留逐步进展。开始工作、出现新缺口或陷入停滞时，带着原目标、必要条件和已知障碍，搜索工具、支持结论和反例，沿引用和结构关系继续查找。没有直接解法时，可以逐级寻找辅助结果、受限版本、估计或可检验方向；每一级都说明取得的进展和仍缺什么，原验收标准保持不变。

Seek direct routes. At start, gaps or stalls, search tools, supporting results and counterexamples using the goal, required conditions and known obstacles; follow references/structural relations. Without a direct route, seek auxiliary results, restricted cases, estimates or testable directions. State each gain and gap; retain original acceptance criteria.
借用类比结论前，先核条件。类比可以帮助寻找表示、搜索词和候选方法；真正借用结论前，要核对对象、假设、操作、所需性质、量词、尺度、结论方向、误差和成本如何对应。能表达或可逆，不保证能操作、能验证或成本相同。指出对应失效的位置和尚待验证的缺项；同名、同数值或统一术语，不能代替对应关系和组合证据。

Validate analogies. Use analogy for representations, queries or candidate methods. Before transfer, match objects, assumptions, operations, needed properties, quantifiers, scale, direction, error and cost. Expressibility/reversibility guarantees no operability, verifiability or equal cost. List broken mappings/pending checks; names, numbers or terms replace neither mappings nor composition evidence.
合并的证据必须能够同时成立。核对它们是否针对同一对象、历史、条件和环境，或是否存在有效对应关系。分别能达到最优，不等于能同时达到；各自的边缘结果一致，不能代替联合关系。上下界要按正确方向使用，总量的上界不是部分的下界。

Combine compatible evidence. Verify the same object, history, conditions and environment, or valid mappings. Separate optima need not coexist; matching marginals do not establish joint relations. Respect bounds’ direction: a total upper bound is no part lower bound.
方便使用的条件未必必要。从最终判据倒推足够的联合条件，允许增益、情形和分支相互补足。分清必要条件、充分条件，以及为简化而加上的更强条件。强条件不成立，不能否定原目标；要检查更弱条件是否已经足够。

Convenient need not be necessary. Derive sufficient joint conditions from final criteria; allow complementary gains, cases or branches. Distinguish necessity, sufficiency and stronger simplifications. A stronger condition’s failure does not refute the goal; test weaker sufficient conditions.
实验结论不超出证据范围。按预定判据，用适用的小实例、退化边界和极端情形区分路线，并做必要的独立核验。分清数值改善、放宽约束后的可行性、实际实现、有限阶段和统一结论，说明近似方向及能否实现。某个方法失败、下界失效或有限样本的结果，不能自动反驳原对象或证明不受这些限制的一般结论。

Bound experimental claims. Use applicable small, degenerate and extreme cases to distinguish routes, with preset criteria and needed independent checks. Distinguish numerical gains, feasible relaxations, realizations, finite-stage and uniform results; state approximation direction and realizability. Failed methods/lower bounds or finite samples do not refute the object or prove unbounded claims by themselves.
已授权协作围绕实际缺口展开。并行工作共享目标、假设和固定版本，在隔离边界内汇合可共享成果与反例。要求独立盲评时，提交独立结论前，不读取同轮其他参与方的结果。汇合时核对是否相容、重复、遗漏或增加了限制。协作收益看缺口缩小了多少，不看参与人数或调用次数。

Combine authorized work. Share goals, assumptions and pinned versions; pool permitted results/counterexamples within isolation. For required blind reviews, submit independent conclusions before reading same-round peers. Check compatibility, duplicates, omissions and added user constraints. Judge gaps closed, not seats/calls.
保留实质，准确标明归属。成果放在已有的对应位置，保留支撑结论的定义、假设、推导、实例和边界。引用或综合不自动算原创；准确区分外部来源、复用内容和本次新增，不为增加产物数量制造包装或使用方。

Keep substance and attribution. Use existing proper locations; retain supporting definitions, assumptions, derivations, examples and limits. Citation/synthesis is not automatically original. Attribute sources, reuse and new work; no wrappers/consumers merely to raise counts.
分开业务状态与工作流状态。明确处理链的输入、输出、实际写入者和状态变化。分别报告工作流是否完成、业务结果是什么，不能相互推断。必要子项和要求全部完成，才能宣称整项完成；失败回执、隔离状态或记录位置，不能冒充最终状态。

Separate domain and workflow. Identify chain inputs, outputs, writers and transitions. Report workflow completion and domain results separately; neither implies the other. Completion requires all necessary subitems/duties. Failure receipts, quarantine or record locations are no terminal success.
按可独立接受的变更控制写入成本。生成物出现写入热点或冲突时，测量权威输入中可独立接受的变更单元、输出写入范围和跨片依赖，不只数输入文件。确需分片时，使用稳定来源键和绑定身份的分区，每片保留全部必要输入。全局证明信息仍可能让名义分片每次全部重写。实测单元变更的影响，样本不能带来永久豁免。聚合指南或 manifest 可以按明确的使用合同保留；分片经验不能变成按目录发现成员，也不能禁止一切聚合。

Partition by independent changes. For generated write hotspots/conflicts, measure acceptable independent source changes, output writes and cross-partition dependencies, not file counts. Use stable source keys, partition-bound identity and full inputs per partition. Global attestation may still rewrite all. Measure unit-change effects; samples grant no lasting exemption. Explicit consumer contracts permit aggregates; no directory discovery or blanket bans.
临时产物按声明的生命周期处理。一次性探针、查询快照和运行产物，按宿主登记的临时归属管理；只供本次运行使用的内容不进版本库。分片只能减少冲突，不能把临时材料变成保留成果。跨会话复用的工具，必须另有可维护的负责方。

Honor temporary lifecycles. One-use probes, query snapshots and run artifacts follow registered host ownership; run-local stays out of version control. Partitioning reduces conflicts; it does not make temporary material worth retaining. Cross-session tools need maintainable owners.
有真实复用或结构压力，再提取抽象。出现第二个真实实例，或已有证据表明结构承压时，才提取共性；出现首个真实工件时，才建目录或项目。没有共性就不造通用机制。程序承载共性，宿主明确登记成员和实例，新增实例不应要求修改通用运行时。

Abstract under real pressure. Require a second real instance or proven structural pressure; create directories/projects with their first artifact. No common structure, no general mechanism. Code owns common behavior; hosts register members/instances explicitly. New instances need no general-runtime edits.
及时纠正共享结论。接手已授权工作时，说明当前认识和方向。旧读数或前提被推翻时，先纠正；根因、处理办法和落地结果确定后，再更新必要结论。更新必须包含可复核的新证据或判断，不留空评论或过程流水。这项要求不授权向外部发送消息。

Correct shared conclusions. On taking authorized work, state understanding/direction. Correct disproved readings/premises first; update conclusions as cause, remedy and landing become known. Give verifiable new evidence/judgment, no empty comments or process streams. This grants no external-messaging authority.
交接要有实际接手依据。只有对方已经认领，并有实测工作或正在交付的证据表明在推进；或者唯一真实来源归对方负责，自己动手会产生第二来源，才可让出工作。说明哪些工作受阻、怎样恢复。接手停滞时，在授权内重新承担，不自行设置等待窗口。局部绕开不等于修复共享根因。

Require handoff evidence. Yield only for claimed work AND (measured work or in-flight delivery showing progress), OR sole source ownership where acting duplicates authority. State blocked scope/resumption actions. Resume within authorization if stalled, without invented waiting windows. Local workarounds do not fix shared causes.
恢复工作前先核上下文。重用失败、被拒绝或长期停滞的工作时，检查陈旧标签、用尽的重试次数和过期前提。只有证据表明当前状态有效，才继续；否则用有效上下文重建，保留有用结论，不继承失效状态。以前重启成功，不证明这次也有效。

Validate resumed context. For failed, rejected or stalled work, check stale labels, spent retries and expired premises. Continue only with valid-state evidence; otherwise rebuild valid context, retaining useful findings, not invalid state. Past restarts do not validate this one.
原样传递输入。正文、提示和路径使用结构化参数或保留原字节的文件，避免 shell 展开美元号、反引号、引号、尖括号和换行。核对必填参数与实际收到的值，不用调用者的当前状态偷偷补齐缺失身份。

Preserve input bytes. Use structured arguments or literal files for text, prompts and paths, avoiding shell expansion of dollars, backticks, quotes, angle brackets and newlines. Check required/received values; never silently fill missing identity from caller state.
对可变数据的观察先固定快照。并发写入或变异测试的读数可能只是瞬时状态；读取固定快照，或在交回后核对采集前后哈希一致。读数冲突时先查采集条件，不凭瞬时读数判定他人错误。临时快照不另存成过程档案。

Snapshot mutable readings. Concurrent writes/mutations may give transient readings. Use fixed snapshots or verify before/after hashes match when control returns. Check collection conditions before blaming peers; do not archive temporary process snapshots.
按可独立验收的职责组织变更。每个单元说明自己的单一职责，能够独立满足验收，意义不依赖后续改动；检查是否夹带无关主题。按当前基线核对冲突和已退役路径，保留成果，不复活被替代实现。分批迁移不能留下永久双轨。

Make changes independently useful. Each unit needs one responsibility, independent acceptance and meaning without future edits; exclude unrelated topics. Check conflicts/retired paths against current baseline. Preserve work without reviving replaced code; batching must leave no permanent dual implementations.
拆分同时考虑冲突和判定差异。测量写入冲突风险，识别哪些部分可以独立通过或失败，按差异和明确依赖划分边界，不按文件数、目录或类别名称猜测。冲突少，只能说明为减少冲突而拆分的收益较小，不能证明各部分判定相同。比较每批验证、协作和同步成本，不虚称存在机器阈值。

Split by conflicts and verdicts. Measure write conflicts and separately passing/failing parts; use these differences and explicit dependencies, not file counts, directories or family names. Low conflict reduces only that splitting benefit, not verdict differences. Compare batch checking, coordination and sync costs; invent no machine thresholds.
声称冲突接近零，必须满足五项前提。若以此为由不按文件数拆分生成批次，必须同时证实：只有新增，没有修改或删除；路径互不重叠，由内容或来源键派生，且没有共享可变文件；没有跨片可变聚合；由唯一规范程序一次确定生成，同样输入得到同样字节，且不是手写；检查不依赖后续交付。未知就不能声称接近零；即使全部满足，仍须核对各部分判定是否不同。

Require five negligible-conflict premises. To cite negligible conflict in a generated batch against file-count splitting: additions only; disjoint paths derived from content/source keys without shared mutable files; no mutable cross-partition aggregates; one canonical producer/run, same inputs give same bytes, no hand authorship; checks independent of later delivery. Verify all five; unknowns defeat the claim. Still check differing verdicts.
渐进迁移不能以新债替旧债。分批清债先禁止同类新增；候选的债务身份集合必须是基线的子集，涉及债务的迁移步骤必须严格缩小该集合，不能用数量未增掩盖等量换债。保留可验证约束和完成条件，证明取得进展。已经声明债务收缩或迁移合同时，删除或停用相关强制检查，必须被检测并判失败。集合缩小不能保证何时清零；清零也不授权全仓重判。

Shrink debt without swaps. Block new debt before batch migration. Candidate identities must be a baseline subset; debt-touching steps strictly shrink it, with no equal-count swaps. Keep verifiable constraints/completion criteria and show progress. Under an applicable declared debt-shrink/migration contract, detect removal or disabling of shrink enforcement as failure. Shrinkage guarantees no end date; zero debt authorizes no full-repo judgment.
控制措施与证据、风险相称。根据实际缺陷、有证据的案例和当前目标，设计负担得起的控制。分清可逆低风险错误，以及影响检测、恢复或不可逆结果的变更。优先消除原因、改善可观察性并快速修复；不穷举假想风险，也不因尚未出事故就一概禁止预防。不得降低检测要求来掩盖失败。

Use proportionate controls. Derive affordable controls from real defects, grounded cases and goals. Separate reversible low-risk errors from effects on detection, recovery or irreversible outcomes. Favor cause removal, observability and quick repair; neither enumerate imagined risks exhaustively nor treat no incidents as a blanket ban on prevention. Never weaken detection to hide failure.
时间相邻不能证明因果。固定最近成功、首次失败、候选变更、环境和具名失败，定位转折点，再用最小复现，或固定其他输入的反事实比较，核对因果。检查是否基线与候选错位，以及是否存在其他解释。只移除该变更，应能消除同一失败；否则归因仍未验证。

Adjacency is not causation. Pin last success, first failure, candidate change, environment and named failure. Locate the turn; test a minimal reproduction or counterfactual fixing other inputs. Check baseline/candidate mismatches and alternatives. Removing only that change must remove the same failure, else cause remains unverified.
最小恢复也要验证。因果成立后，在授权内选择最小且合适的恢复，分清撤去诱因、局部绕开和根因修复，完成适用检查，核对是否实际恢复。逆向变更合入，不代表已经恢复；仍失败就按新证据继续诊断。撤回一项变更不保证历史整树恢复，恢复也不授权普遍绕过检查。

Verify recovery. Once causation is established, choose minimal appropriate authorized recovery. Separate cause removal, workaround and root fix; run applicable checks and inspect recovered state. Inverse merges prove no recovery; diagnose remaining failures. One revert need not restore a historical tree; recovery grants no blanket bypass.
核对检测保证时，也要考虑绕过和未执行。声称能够检测前，列出可能绕过的输入与表示，以及未选中、未接入、跳过或执行程序变化的情形；核对实际使用方，说明已测和未测范围。早期反馈扫描、自检或同一来源反复输出，都不能证明没有其他反例。

Check bypasses and nonexecution. Before claiming detection, list evading inputs/representations, unselected, unwired, skipped checks or changed executables. Verify real consumers and tested/untested scope. Early scans, rule self-checks or repeated same-source output cannot exclude other counterexamples.
由产生信号的程序保证信号准确。定义实例、单位、索引、窗口和含义，失败要明确报告。全历史累计不能回答当前窗口问题，替代指标不能冒充目标读数。完成与否看真实任务退出和产物；是否存活、资源负载如何，要有适用观察，不能凭耗时猜测。可选诊断采集失败单独报告，不改变业务退出结果；合同要求的输入缺失仍须明确失败。信号误导就修产生它的程序，不让读者反复自行警惕。

Fix signal producers. Define instance, units, index, window and meaning; report failure. Historical totals cannot answer current windows; proxies cannot replace target readings. Completion needs real exits/artifacts; liveness/load needs suitable observations, not elapsed guesses. Report optional telemetry failure separately, preserving task exits; missing required contract inputs still fail explicitly. Fix misleading producers, not reader vigilance.
长任务交给宿主生命周期管理。超过前台预算或时长未知的任务，使用实际可用的宿主作业或会话，保留句柄和结果。启动器须等待真实工作结束，收齐内部子进程，并传递真实退出状态；内部并发都在同一生命周期内结束，才算完成。脱离宿主的后台启动、进程仍存在或启动器退出为零，都不能证明成功。

Keep jobs in host lifecycles. Beyond foreground budgets or for unknown durations, use available host jobs/sessions; retain handles/results. Launchers await real work, join all children in that lifecycle and propagate actual exits. Detached launch, process presence or launcher zero proves no task success.

等待任务，并核对原始结果。每项任务优先使用一个实际可用的宿主完成通知，或原生、真正阻塞的等待通道。完成后一次收取并核对原 stdout、stderr、退出码或 signal，以及任务身份。产生结果的程序必须等待自己的子孙进程和后台工作结束，才发布最终状态；调用方也须等待自己另行启动的任务。

禁止短周期反复查询状态、进程或产物，也不能用反复空写会话、sleep 后查询，或改名为 wait/watch 的短周期循环代替等待。允许在授权内对原任务作长周期核实，不另开同时运行的完成通道，也不新增确认关卡。真正阻塞的原生工具可以内部查询，但名称、默认间隔或包装程序退出为零，都不能证明符合等待要求或任务成功。

等待超时、暂缺通知、通道丢失或无法取得结果时，保留原句柄、已有结果和保护，状态保持未知，不重复启动。继续独立且已授权的工作，说明缺少的能力，不另造轮询器或伪造完成。

Wait for tasks and verify the original result. Prefer one actually available host completion notification or genuinely blocking native wait per task; after completion, collect and verify the original stdout/stderr, exit/signal and task identity once. Producers wait for their owned descendants and background work before publishing terminal results; callers still join separately launched tasks. Prohibit short-cycle repeated status, process or artifact queries; do not substitute repeated empty session input, sleep-then-query or short-cycle loops renamed wait/watch for waiting. Long-period reconciliation of the original task is allowed within existing authorization; do not add a simultaneous completion channel or a new confirmation gate. A genuinely blocking native tool may query internally, but its name, default interval or wrapper exit 0 proves neither compliance with waiting requirements nor task success. On timeout, delayed notification, lost channel or unavailable results, retain the original handle, acquired results and protection, keep the state unknown and do not duplicate the task; continue independent authorized work and report capability gaps without adding a poller or fabricating completion.
环境差异要作为明确输入。工具不能依赖个人路径、固定检出目录、shell 启动文件、别名、虚拟环境或未声明配置。项目路径按脚本位置或明确根目录解析；外部路径、服务、凭据和选项由参数或登记配置提供。启动时核对必需值和工具版本，缺失就明确失败。声明平台与安装依赖；能力检测不能自行决定测试选择范围。

Input environment explicitly. No personal paths, fixed checkouts, shell startup, aliases, activated environments or undeclared config. Resolve project paths from scripts/explicit roots; pass external paths, services, credentials and options by parameters/registry. Check required values/tool versions at startup; fail if missing. Declare platforms/install dependencies; probes grant no test-selection authority.
按实际测试报告可移植性。验证入口在不同当前目录、含空格路径和不加载个人 shell 配置时是否可用；平台适配要有明确能力和真实运行支持。说明未测平台和条件，不把本机通过推广成跨平台通过。一次性脚本同样遵守路径和输入约束。

Bound portability claims. Test entries from other working directories, spaced paths, without personal shell config. Support platform adaptations with explicit capabilities/real runs; disclose untested platforms/conditions. Local green gives no cross-platform guarantee. One-use scripts obey path/input rules too.
复用工具要有可维护的归属。跨会话使用，或被指南、skill 依赖的工具，应归入可获得、版本化、可验证的项目或包，宿主明确登记入口，不能藏在一次性目录或个人配置里。能够直接使用已有能力，就不要为“由本仓拥有”再复制平台。纯临时胶水可以留在临时位置。

Maintain reusable tools. Cross-session or guide/skill tools need accessible, versioned, verifiable project/package owners and explicit host entries, not disposable paths or personal config. Use supplied tools; do not copy platforms for repo ownership. Temporary glue may stay temporary.
语义结论要有语义证据。关键引用、定义和调用可达性结论，使用编译器、语言服务器或真实语义使用方核验，核对符号、位置和采集方式。字面搜索只能查文案、常量或收窄范围，不能证明语义。工具缺失就报告能力缺口，不猜测；语义分析不能自行推断权威测试依赖。

Use semantic evidence. For critical reference, definition or reachability claims, use compilers, language servers or semantic consumers; check symbols, locations and methods. Text search checks wording/constants or narrows scope, not semantics. Report missing capability, never guess; analysis grants no test-dependency authority.
查询要绑定完整目标，并核对结果。等待或查询交付时，固定目标，核对结果、检查和运行编号的归属；旧快照不能判定新目标。身份缺失或矛盾、部分错误、分页不完整或超时，都不是成功。分清不可用、失败、未合并和完成；包装程序合并了不同退出码时，读取规范结果。

Bind query identity. Pin delivery targets; verify result/check/run ownership. Old snapshots cannot judge new targets. Missing/conflicting identity, partial errors, incomplete pages or timeout are not success. Distinguish unavailable, failed, unmerged and complete; read canonical results if wrappers collapse exits.
集成证据只覆盖实际行为。验证时保留适用的保护和执行条件，逐项对应交付环境。安装后核对首个真实运行。替代事件只能证明实际运行的版本、权限和行为；原生路线未触发或未覆盖的部分，仍是缺口。候选修复须回到交付版本，变化或证据失效的部分要补验。证据充分就停止；次数、耗时、旧检查通过或标题，都不能代替覆盖和落地。

Bound integration evidence. Preserve applicable protections/execution conditions; map each to delivery. Check first run after installation. Substitute events prove only actual versions, permissions and behavior; uncovered native routes remain gaps. Deliver candidate fixes; recheck changed/invalid scope. Stop with sufficient evidence; counts, time, old greens or titles prove no coverage/landing.
读取声明不产生新的权威。完整性校验、索引、编译器增量和测试，只读取或验证已经声明的材料，不发现或扩大归属、输入及影响范围。完整范围已明确登记且确实无需资源时，才报告 not-required。登记未知不等于无工作，缓存命中不等于检查通过。

Consumption grants no authority. Integrity checks, indexing, compiler increments and tests consume declared material, never expand/discover ownership, inputs or impact. Only a complete scope explicitly needing no resources is not-required. Unknown registration is not no work; hits are not passes.
纯转发也要保真。调用规范工具前，核对全部必需输入，保留参数、真实退出状态和完成结果，并保证幂等或安全重跑。若自行解析结构、判断通过或失败、维护状态，就按关键程序验证；不要为胶水程序复制被调用工具的测试套件。

Forward faithfully. Check all required inputs before canonical tools; preserve arguments, real exits and completion results; allow idempotent/safe reruns. Parsing structure, judging outcomes or maintaining state needs critical-code checks. Do not duplicate callee suites for pure glue.
从实际使用方核对引用目标。路径、类型、组件、摘要和入口字段，须由实际使用方核对目标是否存在、身份是否正确、内容是否一致；语法正确不等于引用完整。新增关键引用时，同步提供核验它的使用方。当前已有承诺却没有检测时，补充检测，或明确退役字段及其承诺，不留虚假保证。

Validate targets. Real consumers must check existence, identity and consistency of path, type, component, digest and entry references; syntax is insufficient. Supply consumers with new critical references. Check active promises or explicitly retire fields/promises; no false assurance.
变异要命中预定断言。预先确定变异位置、预期失败的测试和数量。有效反例必须能够编译、测试退出非零，并命中具名失败；别处失败或编译错误不算。记录结果、还原并复验，预期独立于实现。失败数多了或少了，要分析越界、遗漏或恒真，不能事后凑数。拒绝和放行两侧都要验证，防止全部拒绝也算通过。同时核对新增和删除的测试身份；净数量相等，不能证明原检测得到保留。

Target mutation assertions. Predeclare position, failing tests/count. Valid mutations compile, exit nonzero in tests and hit named failures; other red/compile errors do not count. Record results, restoration and recheck; expectations stay independent of implementation. Explain extra/missing failures as overreach, gaps or tautologies, never fit counts afterward. Test accept/reject against reject-all. Check added/deleted test identities; equal counts prove no preserved detection.
换上下文验证选择行为。changed-path 或条件检查，要在影响范围内外核对实际行为；只在修改检查的分支通过，可能仅验证了放行一侧。新项目、路由和接线，要核对实际选中与未选中的结果，不能凭静态存在证明执行过。

Vary selection contexts. Test changed-path/conditional checks inside/outside their closure. Green on the check-changing branch alone may cover only acceptance. Verify selected/unselected behavior of new projects, routes and wiring; static presence proves no execution.
DELTA 必须有完整端点。固定并核对 before、after 和实际候选，覆盖全部提交范围，以及删除、改名的两端。不能用单父提交或截断的路径列表替代。缺对象，或普通范围无效、不完整时，明确失败，不能谎报空差异或改跑全测兜底。没有前序的新树使用明确的初始输入模式；删除事件没有候选，不能报告当前树通过。

Validate DELTA endpoints. Pin/check before, after and actual candidate. Include all commits and both deletion/rename ends, not single parents or truncated path lists. Missing objects and invalid/incomplete ordinary ranges fail, never mean empty diffs or all-check fallback. Without predecessors use explicit initial-input mode; candidate-less deletion events cannot pass current trees.
读取全部，不等于判定全部。定位和索引可以读取全部材料，一次性对齐或迁移可以重建必要产物，但不授权每次对全仓历史重新判定。测试选择关系仍来自明确登记，读取到的依赖不会自动取得权威。应触发实际受影响的对应值，不只看路径前缀或改名。

Full reads are not full judgments. Locating/indexing may read all; one-time alignment/migration may rebuild needed artifacts. Neither authorizes repeated whole-history judgment. Selection edges stay registered; observed dependencies gain no authority. Activate for affected values, not just path prefixes/renames.
按合同推导资源。推导并发、驻留量和预算前，声明受控量、单位、合法取值范围、需求、上限、保留量和失败边界，不能凭参数名判断容量问题。不同单位不能混算；分清 request 与 limit、强制上限与实测峰值。缺数据就报告无法推导，容量不足不能硬设至少一项。区分政策指定值和推导值，说明例外依据及复核条件。

Declare resource contracts. Before concurrency/residency/budget derivation, state quantities, units, domains, demand, limits, reserves and failure boundaries. Names do not define capacity problems. Do not mix units, requests/limits or enforced bounds/measured peaks. Missing data prevents derivation; never force one unit into insufficient capacity. Separate policy/derived values; justify exceptions/review conditions.
静态容量与动态观察分开。启动时的静态合同，按声明容量和固定需求求值，不能用负载、可用内存或瞬时 RSS 替换需求，也不能据此反馈改值。固定其他输入，核对确定性、合法范围边界，以及容量变化后输出是否有效。动态反馈必须另有明确的状态、稳定性和失败合同；诊断信息不能自动成为控制输入。

Separate capacity and observations. For static startup contracts, use declared capacity/fixed demand, never substitute or feed back load, free memory or transient RSS. Hold other inputs fixed; test determinism, domain boundaries and outputs as capacity changes. Dynamic feedback needs separate state, stability and failure contracts. Diagnostics are not automatically controls.
缓存问题分两层诊断。异常缓慢或失效时，先看本次命中、键、种子和恢复情况，再测下游增量、重编范围和主要成本；只有一层读数，不足以支持修法。缓存正常但仍昂贵，就分析程序、表示和依赖，保留可比较的前后结果及无改进结论，不用等待、加缓存或重跑掩盖错误表示。

Check both cache layers. For slow builds/misses, inspect this run’s hit, key and seed/restore, then measure downstream increments, rebuild scope and costs. One layer cannot justify fixes. If warm caches remain costly, profile code, representations and dependencies; keep comparable before/after and negative results. Waiting, extra caches or reruns cannot hide poor representations.
性能证据保留比较条件。对齐源码、载荷、工具链、硬件、缓存和采集口径，报告真实时间、峰值资源、重建量及限制，保留必要的无改进结论。先减少无用驻留、低效结构和过宽依赖，再测量。本地通过或资源降低，不能证明远端故障原因；需要远端证据，并排除其他解释。

Preserve performance comparisons. Compare source, workload, toolchain, hardware, cache and collection basis; report time, peak resources, rebuild volume, limits and needed negative findings. Reduce excess residency, poor structures and broad dependencies; remeasure. Local success/savings prove no remote cause; get remote evidence and exclude alternatives.
复用已验结果，必须覆盖全部有效输入。只有求值确定，且身份涵盖全部影响结果或接受语义的输入，才可直接复用。输入、政策、执行程序、工具链或环境变了，就重新判定有效性。内容哈希或缓存命中，不能自行证明输入完整或检查通过。

Reuse complete inputs only. Direct reuse of validated results needs determinism and identity covering all inputs affecting results or acceptance. Reassess after input, policy, executable, toolchain or environment changes. Hashes/hits prove neither complete inputs nor passed checks.
缓存种子由权威下游补验。缓存只是近似起点时，可以扩大匹配范围，避免无关字段导致不必要失效；但剩余差异必须由已有的权威增量机制验证，不能自造经验规则。分析缺少字段造成的误命中，以及无关字段造成的误失效。证明相关字段和补验合同后，才缩小键，不能无条件删除全文或 commit 身份。

Validate seeds downstream. Approximate seeds may select broadly to avoid irrelevant misses; existing authoritative incrementality must check remaining delta, not custom heuristics. Analyze omitted-input false hits and irrelevant-input false misses. Narrow keys only with evidence of relevant fields/downstream contracts; never unconditionally drop file/commit identity.
兼容版本必须有条件依据。只有存在明确且有证据的合同，才用语义版本表示产生结果的程序是否兼容。结果或接受语义变化时，同步更新版本和验证；声称仍兼容，也要有依据。机器不会自动推导兼容性，漏更新可能复用旧结果。不能普遍排除程序、政策、工具链和环境身份。

Declare compatibility conditionally. Producer semantic versions need explicit justified contracts. Update versions/checks together for result or acceptance changes; continued compatibility needs evidence too. Machines infer no compatibility; missed updates reuse stale results. Never universally omit program, policy, toolchain or environment identity.
缓存不能掩盖构建失败。报告复用和程序构建各按登记职责执行；缓存命中后，仍须完成选中的增量构建和检查。选中构建失败必须退出非零，不能留下成功状态。明确没有工作才省去资源，不能用报告命中覆盖失败。

Caches cannot hide build failures. Reports/builds follow registered duties; hits still require selected incremental builds/checks. Selected build failures must exit nonzero, leave no success state. Omit resources only for explicit no-work cases; report hits cannot mask failure.
必要查询不算无用重放。后续判断需要的查询仍须执行；反复证明固定字节没变，不会增加证据。根据实际重复情况和成本选择结果记忆化，不因一次必要查询提到“缓存”就另造机制。保留后续所需输入和结果，不为查询旧状态的错误问题重建旧工具链。环境升级按现行规则和明确影响验证，Git 字节不能证明语义。

Run necessary queries. Run queries needed for later judgments; re-proving fixed bytes adds no evidence. Memoize by measured repetition/cost, not for one needed query. Retain needed inputs/results; do not rebuild old toolchains for mistaken historical questions. Check environment upgrades under current rules and explicit impact; Git bytes prove no semantics.
新检查器要带真实首例。交付新检查器或复用验证设施时，必须有具体输入、实际结果工件或成功证据、正确性合同在该例中的应用，以及实际解决的问题；缺一都不能称为端到端验证。空接口、未履行的假设或无关玩具例，不能代替实际用途。

Ship a real first case. New checkers/reusable validators need concrete input, actual result artifacts or success evidence, the correctness contract applied to that case, and a problem solved. All four precede end-to-end claims; empty interfaces, unmet assumptions or unrelated toys do not count.

及时清理，并保全工作。按宿主登记的生命周期入口保护正在使用的对象，等待全部自有任务和后台任务，核对完成与落地情况，并做好交接。已经采用且验证的自动恢复或清理路径，应在保留条件满足、使用方结束后，及时回收可重建临时产物，包括会话中断后的产物；不能只靠记得执行 finish，回收缓存也不代表工作完成。

删除前，核对实际归属、是否仍在使用、必要使用方和保留条件，保护源码、尚未保全的独有工作与提交，以及仍需保留的证据。失败原件保留到调试和验收义务完成，不默认永久留存。明确删除资格并检查活跃使用后，可以采用普通 TTL 保留策略；年龄、目录名或空闲本身，都不能证明任意文件可删。具体操作、兼容部署和恢复边界，由宿主上下文及生命周期负责方维护。

Clean promptly and preserve work. Use the host’s registered lifecycle entry to protect consumption, join all owned/background jobs, verify completion/landing and hand off. Adopted and verified automatic recovery/cleanup paths should promptly expire and reclaim reproducible temporary output once retention conditions are met and consumers finish, including after interrupted sessions; do not rely only on remembering finish. Cache disposal never claims completion. Before deletion, check actual ownership, active use, required consumers and retention conditions; protect source, unretained unique work/commits and still-needed evidence. Keep original failure evidence until debugging/acceptance obligations finish, not forever by default. Ordinary TTL retention is allowed after eligibility and active-use checks are declared; age, directory names or idle time alone prove no arbitrary file disposable. Host context and the lifecycle owner define operations, compatible rollout and recovery limits.

在用户授权的仓库和发布范围内推进到真实采用；没有授权的其他仓库不自动纳入。先读各仓库的 AGENTS 与 host_context，定位当前发布、安装、检查和生命周期登记。此 skill 不授予额外权限，也不要求再次确认已经授权的发布与合并。

在 chrono-harness 中，以当前检出根的 `docs/release-iteration.md` 为迭代验收来源；`docs/release-ci.md` 管发布及恢复，`docs/distribution.md` 管安装，`docs/examples.md` 确定四个现役下游。此 skill 的唯一维护源是 `.chrono-harness/instructions/catalog.json` 的 `core.release-iteration`；manifest 登记的仓库 skill 和个人目录都是生成或安装副本。修改登记源后执行正式指令生成入口，再同步个人副本。没有本地检出时先取得已授权仓库的固定修订，不凭移动网页代替候选输入；其他产品先定位其等效合同，不套用本仓仓库名或入口。

先完成一个测试版，再迁移下游。固定成功落地 CI 的源码 SHA、run 和原 attempt，检查是否已有该身份的自动发布；接续它，只有确无原运行才显式触发 preview。发布工作流列表中的 head 不一定是发行源码，核原 CI、回执、清单和标签的共同身份。等待原运行及两平台安装结果，核公开资产后才把版本交给下游。

手动派发前同时固定工作流修订：`source` 只控制检出，`--ref` 控制 GitHub 实际执行的工作流。正式版使用已核验、指向同一源码的最终测试版标签作为 `--ref`，并核新 run 的工作流 head。移动的 dev 若已改 needs／downloads，不能用新拓扑执行旧候选。发现实际派发输入不符时，保留差异和原件，终止尚未公开的错误运行并等待最终状态，再从匹配的固定 ref 派发；不移动标签，不把取消后的缺产物错误解释成产品回归。自动触发的工作流修订也须核适用性，不能只看源码参数。

采用带工作流预检的新候选时，核两平台 frontend 的 `workflow` 观察及原 `workflow.json`。不同提交可含同一个工作流 blob，不能仅因 head 不同就重建；字节不同、缺绑定或 Git 失败时，保留失败原件并按负责文档从固定 ref 恢复。旧候选没有该观察，不能补写成已经执行。

逐个比较下游已采用版本与候选的 schema、CLI、安装声明、工具绑定、生成源和宿主定制。用候选安装器显式 adopt 固定版本，再使用下游登记的入口生成和验证；不只替换版本字符串，也不以 init 覆盖定制。保持业务测试和初始清单合同，从各自最新目标分支隔离迁移，核 PR 实际合并、落地 SHA 和落地 CI。自动合并不可用时沿下游已登记的现有权限入口完成交付，不申请新权限或另加确认；无法修改的远端配置保留精确限制。

检查期间固定该检出的 HEAD 和已跟踪输入，等原任务结束再提交新修复；输入漂移的失败不能赋给新候选。宿主迁移的短命令、平台政策、旧输出所有权、上传根及 runner 可用性边界按负责文档核对。精确 Git pin 从本候选 bootstrap 原回执更新，保持各下游定制。

失败先读原 stdout／stderr／退出及实际输入，在产生问题的负责处修复。断言只显示预期而丢失实际返回时，先在原断言补输入与完整返回诊断；旧原因保持未知，不由新候选成功反推。产品修复重新走 dev、测试版和受影响下游验收；下游局部失败不阻断独立工作。保留原失败和恢复条件，相同症状需要相同处理第二次时修复产生处，不作第三次盲重试。复用现有发布者的 draft 续传，不 clobber 公开资产、不移动版本标签、不改成功要求。

PR 等待用例先核首次 API 的原退出。未取得有效远端观察的超时须按 PR 合同保持 unknown，取得 pending 观察后的到期另核；不能把任意退出 2 当作合格结果。按原生产者回执核实际派发，保留原期限和原生等待输入；替身自身的部分日志不能代替完整调用回执。

会合回归先保留已等待终结的驱动进程返回，再解释控制线程的 socket 断言。`poll` 到期不读取 errno；内层 CI 静默超时复用测试宿主已有阶段日志政策和原输出上限，沿原期限验收。诊断补齐只提高可观察性，不能报告旧超时已修复。

启动失败先核意图和原系统错误，不能当作业务断言失败。`ETXTBSY` 要审查可执行输入的写入／描述符生命周期；并发测试复用不可修改的已封口执行物，内容变异使用独立副本。补启动前意图与失败回执，不以重试、减线程或加期限掩盖。生产复制／解包后的执行仍须原生发布验收。

最后关闭与即时回收断言遇到元数据繁忙时，核原进度并复用已有单用例隔离，排除无关 fork 继承租约的干扰；保留父套件默认并发、维护轮数及预算，具体持锁者缺证仍保持未知。

命令替身也计入实际身份校验和执行成本。超时先核原回执及实际落地源码中的替身依赖／体积和各阶段读数；并行迁移后的工具闭包不能由原 feature 或 integration 代证。简单高频接口复用已有标准库小替身，移除仅为较大替身所需的设置，保留当前 mock 边界及 argv、输入、输出与退出合同。不改构建配置、线程、用例或期限来消除失败；新执行物仍走原 canonical 与原生发布验收。

fetch 替身超时还要按迭代文档核共享对象的重复写入与本地不可变对象复用，先用回归证明问题，再验缺失输入和浅历史边界。不同阶段的超时分别保留原因与测量，不能仅凭症状相同合并归因。

本地超时诊断按迭代文档选择 canonical 单元入口；同名 operation 的其他入口可能采用不同期限。固定失败候选和采样身份，等检出创建完成后再导入，保留原现场与后续 DELTA 验收。

中断回归未取得握手时，核 wrapper 是否仍在准备输入；复用已有受管等待入口及原登记期限，先取得使用方握手再实施中断。不能把测试主动提前杀死准备进程解释成产品恢复失败，仍保留提前退出原件与未知使用保护断言。

握手已取得后再超时，按迭代文档核同一期限内的准备与维护，保留实际维护返回和阶段耗时；不由缓存消失推断提前清理活租约。按登记选择包含失败用例的单元，未执行的用例不能由绿色结果代证。

缓存独立地址的中断用例还须核原探测期限内的完整独立计划与维护，等待驱动终结并保留完整返回和累计阶段耗时。`kill` 的进程不存在错误不能解释进程结束原因；沿原期限、线程和断言定位实际负责处。

已有进程日志的握手前超时，先分开启动前准备和子进程运行。按负责流程审计重复读取／校验，复用原引擎的启动前身份核对时仍保留缓存及返回后漂移保护；不从前置阶段慢直接推断哈希或死锁，不改变期限与线程来通过。

独立计划返回过晚时，复用已采用的有限 debug 阶段日志，按相同 CLI PID／尝试区分探测、输入返回、结果封存、原件核验、计划发布和依赖绑定。累计墙钟只在同一函数起点内作差，不能把文件 mtime 或总耗时当作 CPU 根因。原任务终结后核完整输出和日志，再修已证实的重复工作；记录阶段不等于修复旧超时。判法和成本边界由迭代文档负责。

年龄回归的多阶段输入按负责文档安排：复用阶段不与删除条件抢时间，进入删除阶段显式采用原阈值，核创建时间未重置并保留全部保全、复用及删除断言。业务保留政策与执行时限分别核对，不改时钟、账本或执行期限。

恢复同一发布时，先等原运行真实终结，再按显式依赖和仍有效的原件选择最小重跑。新 job ID／当前 attempt 可能只是沿用结果，须核选中 artifact 和原回执的实际生产身份。部分重跑仍受平台总时间窗约束；原输入全部过窗时刷新受影响平台的 frontend 及依赖闭包，不只重跑 collector，也不提高预算。控制面 `in_progress`、取消 409 或观察 502 均须保留原状态并接续等待，不能据此重复派发。具体判法由发布恢复文档维护。

满足负责文档的全部稳定条件后才选择 stable；正式版本须与固定源码内计划一致。计划变动产生新候选，先为它发最终测试版并验收。发布正式版后核公开状态、标签源码、全部资产及两平台安装，再迁移下游到正式版并核实际落地。只证明到哪一阶段，就报告到哪一阶段；unknown 不算稳定。

本仓已采用 `dev`／`main` 合同：正式发布前按迭代文档的唯一晋升入口，将 `main` 非强制快进到最终测试版的完整源码 OID 并回读核对。原 dev CI 与最终测试版身份保留；不制造新合并提交、不移动标签，也不把分支晋升当作公开发布。

采用晋升合同的候选还须显式固定最终测试版发布的 run／attempt。按负责文档核成功原运行、实际生产 attempt／artifact ID、原平台时间窗、工作流字节、原 CI 和公开资产，再由现有发布者消费原包并生成新的正式输出。原回执保持测试版身份，正式回执记录来源；同源码不自动取得复用资格。缺失、过期或损坏原件阻止晋升，不回退重建、不改写旧记录。分别核正式版实际执行的作业、继承的原验证与新安装结果；成本比较沿用相同单位和窗口。

选最终候选时按负责文档核仍有效的失败；scoped CI 的后续绿色不能清除未选中且仍由该源码继承的失败。核相关修复及适用原件，再判断稳定，不靠无关通过或全仓重跑代替。发布来源 CI 与安全扫描各核已登记工作流、固定源码和结论；按迭代文档核 CodeQL 的动态事件，不把来源 CI 的 push 条件套给安全扫描。

文件写入成功不代表结果已封存。封存绑定失败时，核原阶段、结果绑定与恢复引用；用可控的预算边界回归验证同一原件续接，保留真实内容错误。报告字节删除、元数据引用解绑和最终地址退役分别核实际状态与所持能力；字节缺失或一轮结束不表示全部完成。续接回归保留替换条目保护、原件、原结果和仍在使用的引用。处理方式见负责流程，不以提高预算或重复发布掩盖部分完成；缺原状态的旧失败仍保持未知。

检查通过而原生作业在缓存封存失败时，按负责流程核实际选中操作及缺失产物；步骤成功不能证明所有静态缓存都已生成。缺失的可选产物由缓存所有者记录并停止保存，类型、权限和内容错误继续失败。不补跑无关测试、创建空目录或关闭核验；整轮 CI 失败仍不可交给发布者。

采用前从下游现役安装声明读取完整工具映射；adopt 后逐项比较工具及安装位置，不能凭记忆手列子集。版本、manifest、两平台 installer 和工具成员分别核对；宿主上下文若仍写旧版本，保持分发声明为实际安装权威并修正过时说明。

验证分类必须绑定实际进入候选编译／证明的源码。只登记另一个没有包含受影响文件的根不能取得覆盖；新增的边界预期应使用真实运行的同源实现，明确局部证明与原生 IO 测试各自的范围，不能通过改成 data 或关闭门控消除缺口。新接入证明根的源码须能由实际证明编译器的 edition 解析，原生专属 cfg 不豁免语法解析；在负责源码使用等价语法，保留原证明入口。

本地 canonical 与 PR 使用的基线不同，先核实际 request 的 base／candidate 和 PR 的目标、合并候选；分别保留输入差异与真实失败。目标分支前移本身不要求追平或重跑全部检查，只有实际冲突和明确依赖变化触发补验，不能把本地结果赋给另一棵远端树。

临时检出或等待通道缺失时，先核原任务、固定提交和保留引用；保护尚未保全的工作，再从已有身份恢复。目录缺失的原因保持未知，不能据此重新发布同一版本、重置分支或覆盖旧失败。

每轮用 PR／Release 引用原运行、版本、下游提交和未解决事项，复用原件的有限保留政策。原生等待通道丢失时保留句柄；长时间 `gh run watch` 的认证失败或网络读取超时不等于发布失败，用现有权限读取同一 run 并接续只读等待，不重新派发发布。用户取消或必要输入不可取得时停止依赖它的外部操作，交接精确恢复条件。不要为了持续而生成没有净改动或没有使用方的新版本。

收尾按各宿主已采用的生命周期执行。未采用 `automatic_cleanup` 时使用现有显式 cleanup 计划，不套用产品宿主的 `finish`，也不临时启用清理政策。核精确目标、保留引用、活跃使用方与失败原件的保留条件，再处置合格产物；入口拒绝不算清理完成。

把真实执行暴露的非显然问题修进本 skill 或其唯一负责文档；保留宿主特定边界，删除已被当前入口取代的提示。校验 skill 格式，执行变更所需的已登记检查，再用真实发布与下游结果检验指导是否有效。仓库中的此文件由登记源生成；更新个人目录的安装副本时同步已验收的生成结果，不维护另一套流程。
